units: Selected factual annotations, no exhaustive event count
note: Original paraphrases with primary citations. Coordinates approximate named city/region anchors, not footprints. A date may mark a reporting cutoff rather than the onset of an event; the card says which.

items.title: NASA comparison (published)
items.text: NASA published January, March and May 2022 composites around Kyiv. Selected cloud-free nights and Landsat context support the display comparison.

items.title: A hydropower system disrupted
items.text: Kakhovka’s destruction affected water supply as well as the hydropower facility. The UN assessment distinguishes downstream flooding and upstream loss of water.
